description: PFC FISH intrinsic families for scripted model inspection, validation, and control - balls, clumps (pebbles/templates), walls (facets/servo), rigid blocks, contacts, the fracture/DFN system, and model-level utilities (measure/inlet/fragment/domain/cfd/brick).

items.name: model-utilities
items.full_name: Measurement, Inlet, Fragment, Domain, CFD & Brick FISH Intrinsics

verification: Authored 2026-08-15 from the complete live 'fish list intrinsics' table of PFC3D 9.7 (3754 names dumped; the seven family files carry the full per-family inventories - 1290 PFC-family names - plus curated examples with verbatim live signatures). The dump is a UNIFIED-KERNEL table: it also lists other engines' families (block.*, zone.*, struct.*, ...) which are omitted here. Re-checked against the complete live 'fish list intrinsics' table of PFC3D 6.00 (1542 names): each family file stamps the names that do not exist on 6.0 in live_inventory.absent_on['6.0'] (244 names). The brick.* family (20 names on 9.7, 8 on 6.0) was absent from this reference until the 6.0 pass surfaced it. The complete live 7.00 table (3793 names) pins each absent-on-6.0 name to its introduction version via live_inventory.absent_on['7.0']: 147 appeared in 7.0 (the entire inlet.* namespace, the brick extent/corner accessors, clump.template.aangle* - renamed from 6.0's clump.template.axis.angle* - the *.contact.list / *.group.list iterator forms, the *.convergence / *.ratio solve metrics, ball.zone.* and clump.stress.*), and 97 are 9.x-only (the ball.fluid.* / wall.fluid.* / contact.fluid.* coupling namespaces, contact.gps/joint/spin*/vel*, fracture.from.contact, fracture.intersect.id). rblock.intersect exists on 6.00 and 9.7 but not on 7.00.
